growth_reel.caption:
Have you ever wondered why the best coffee to gift in India rarely comes from massive commercial supermarket brands?

Most people assume that higher price tags mean superior farming and better-sourced beans. But behind the glossy packaging of legacy FMCG giants lies a completely different reality. A massive chunk of your hard-earned money goes straight into global warehousing, long supply chains, and heavy media budgets rather than the actual ingredients inside your cup.

When brands scale to millions of units, uniformity replaces quality. They have to process beans to survive months on a dark retail shelf, which strips away the natural origin notes and leaves behind that familiar bitter taste.

Understanding how your morning brew travels from farm to cup completely changes how you look at grocery store aisles. When you choose brands that invest in the bean instead of the billboard, the difference is instant.
